svg.desc: ScadaCraft OpenBridge widget: Vertical gauge (bar) (obc-gauge-vertical, OpenBridge 1.0.0, Apache-2.0). Library: OpenBridge · Instruments. Box 96x288 px, anchor at (0,0). Bindable properties: _pn_value (default 0, read): Process value _pn_min (default 0, read): Scale minimum _pn_max (default 100, read): Scale maximum _pb_hasSetpoint (default false, read): Show the setpoint marker _pn_setpoint (default 0, read): Setpoint (shown when _pb_hasSetpoint is true) _ps_fillMode (default 'fill', read): Bar fill: fill | tint _pb_labels (default true, read): Show scale labels _ps_priority (default 'regular', read): Colour priority: regular | enhanced _pb_off (default false, read): Instrument off (greyed out)
